column3: kmeans_fit calls it UNCONDITIONALLY at detail/kmeans.cuh:872, before any init. It is not an assertion: it cub-reduces the weights and, if the sum != n_samples, RESCALES every weight by n_samples/sum (kmeans_common.cuh:160-172) with only a RAFT_LOG_DEBUG. The rescale cancels in the centroids (update_centroids divides by wtInCluster) but NOT in the inertia, which is weighted at detail/kmeans.cuh:521-526 and is what the n_init loop selects on and what fit reports. Ours takes the caller's weights as given, so any weight vector not summing to n_samples yields an inertia scaled by sum/n_samples relative to cuML's
